notes.title: 日本語アップデート！Japanese added!
notes.content: As a proper visual novel, we should have the option to play the game in Japanese, now we have. Thank you and special thanks to Nicolith for the translation. ありがとうございます!

notes.title: First little update
notes.content: Little update to fix the English Typos and Input Name.

notes.title: Oops, some details slipped!
notes.content:
Who would've thought that making a game could be hard!

This little visual experience of mine is the first time I ever meddled with game development. Even though I learned a lot, there a still some details that slipped my own avaliation. 
We got some typos to correct with the English Version (which I wrote and reviewed myself lol), so we'll be updating that. Our name input had character limits!!!(I didn't know about that). So we'll also fix that.

Thank you so much for the comprehension and the support, I'm doing my best.
Special thanks to WaveHolder for pointing it out!
